item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.5.0

SupaSidebar 1.5.0 brings an Arc-style pill for your current tab, a fuller Space menu, one key for Compact Mode and a new Labs page with two features to try early.

What’s New

  • Labs - A new Labs page in Settings lets you try new beta features early. They’re part of Pro, and each one is free for 30 days.
  • Open Links From Other Apps in SupaView (Labs) - Make SupaSidebar your default browser and links from Slack, Mail or Terminal open in a small floating window.
  • Stay Signed In to SupaView (Labs) - Import your browser’s logins so sites in SupaView open signed in, and keep them in sync.
  • Archived Tabs (Labs) - Have tabs you stop using close on their own and wait in an archive for 30 days, ready to reopen.
  • SupaView From the Command Panel - ⇧Return now opens a Command Panel result in SupaView, and Settings lets you swap it with ⌘Return.
  • SupaView Links for Raycast and Alfred - Open any page or web search in SupaView from Raycast, Alfred or another app with a supasidebar://peek link.
  • Recall Past Searches - Press the Up arrow in an empty Command Panel to bring back your recent searches, newest first.
  • Open Sites Stay Visible in Closed Folders - A closed folder now shows the site you’re on beneath it, like Arc, and every open site it holds when Hide Saved Tabs is on.

Improvements

  • Peek Is Now SupaView - The small floating window for links is now called SupaView everywhere in SupaSidebar.
  • One SupaView Window per Link - Each link now opens in its own SupaView window, like Little Arc, instead of replacing the one already open.
  • Slimmer SupaView Toolbar - SupaView’s toolbar is now slimmer, and its Open button’s menu lists your browser profiles and Default Browser.
  • SupaView Keyboard Shortcuts - ⌘W now closes a SupaView window, and ⌘O opens its page in your browser.
  • Arc-Style Current Tab Pill - The page your browser is on now always gets a rounded pill in Saved, Live Tabs and pinned tabs, with no setting to turn on.
  • Fuller Space Menu - Right-click a Space icon or empty sidebar space to switch Spaces, paste a link, add a folder, change its color or delete it.
  • One Key for Compact Mode - ⌘ now collapses and expands Compact Mode, and Settings lets you leave ⌘[ and ⌘] to your browser’s Back and Forward.
  • Browser Shortcuts Stay Out of Other Apps - Smart Save, Smart Copy and other browser and Finder shortcuts now only take their keys while a browser or Finder is in front.
  • Command Panel Starts Fresh - After you open or search something, the Command Panel now opens empty instead of showing your last query.
  • Arc-Like Space Bar - Space icons now sit centered between Trash and +, and spread out as the sidebar gets wider.
  • Cleaner Clicks in the Sidebar - Clicking a row no longer leaves a grey cursor behind, and the arrow keys still show it when you need it.
  • SupaView Remembers Its Size - SupaView now keeps the size you set, even after you restart SupaSidebar.
  • Dismiss the Drag to Pin Hint - The “Drag to pin” box now has an X, and Appearance settings can bring it back.
  • New Tab Button Matches Your Tabs - The New Tab button now has the same height, icon and text size as the live tabs below it.
  • Search Bar Lines Up With Your Rows - The Search links bar now lines up with your sidebar rows, with a small margin and rounder corners.

Bug Fixes

  • Live Tabs no longer goes blank after you open a link in a Chrome, Brave or other Chromium browser profile.
  • Live Tabs now shows a loading placeholder while you switch Spaces, instead of another profile’s tabs.
  • Safari profile tabs in Live Tabs no longer stay empty after you jump to a full-screen window.
  • Switching to a Space linked to a Chrome or Safari window in full screen or on another Desktop now goes to that window instead of opening a new one.
  • Hovering links from the same site, like YouTube videos, now shows each link’s own preview image instead of the same one.
  • Clicking a folder twice quickly now opens and closes it instead of starting a rename.
  • Opening or closing a folder no longer flickers.
  • Keyboard shortcuts in the sidebar now work right after you leave Compact Mode.
  • Renaming a link or folder in a tinted Space now shows dark, readable text instead of white text on a light box.
  • An Air Traffic Control open rule with no website and no Space no longer catches every link, and now shows “Needs a space”.
  • Deleting a Space now also removes the Air Traffic Control rule linked to it.
  • Clicking anywhere on a Space header now opens and closes it, not just its name.
  • Saved links and live tabs now show favicons at the same size, and live tab favicons are no longer dimmed.
  • Live Tabs browser headers now use up and down arrows to reorder, so moving down no longer looks like collapsing.
  • A faint Space tint in dark mode no longer shows white arrows next to dark text.
  • Opening a SupaView page in your browser now opens the page you’re on, not the link the window first opened.
  • Open Tab in Other Browser now works in Wavebox, Helium, Dia, Comet, Zen and browser betas.

item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0-beta.2

What’s New

  • Updated Onboarding: New setups now use a browser-aware flow that helps you choose useful sites, configure how SupaSidebar opens, and reach your first working sidebar faster.
  • Search Settings: Find preferences from one search field, jump directly to the right section, and change supported toggles from the results.
  • Scoped Search Shortcuts: Assign optional shortcuts that open the Command Panel directly in the Live Tabs or Saved scope.
  • Precise Auto-Close Duration: Choose a custom timeout using any combination of days, hours, and minutes.
  • Local Folder Preview Sorting: Order files and subfolders by Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Date Modified Newest, or Date Modified Oldest. Name sorting handles numbered files naturally, so Export 2 appears before Export 10.

Improvements

  • Smart Attach Stays in Sync: The menu and Preferences now agree with the sidebar’s actual attachment mode.
  • Sidebar Size and Position Are Remembered: A sidebar you move or resize returns to the same position and height after relaunching SupaSidebar.
  • Auto-Show Is Opt-In for New Setups: The sidebar does not appear automatically when you focus a browser unless you enable Auto Show on Browser Focus.
  • Command Panel shortcut hints now adapt better when the panel has limited space.

Bug Fixes

  • Live Tabs search no longer hides an open tab when the same URL is also saved in SupaSidebar.
  • Dragging a link or folder into a folder no longer moves the entire sidebar window.

Notes

  • Local Folder Preview Sorting applies to Finder-style folder preview columns. It does not rearrange your saved SupaSidebar folders.
